column2: By-law on the Maintenance of Tea, Coffee and Short Eat Shops in Yatiyanthota  Pradeshiya  Sabha
This By-Law is enacted to regulate, administer and standardize the operation of the Tea Coffee Shops, Short-
selling Points within the Yatiyanthota Pradeshiya Sabha Authoritative Area.
This by-law is known as the By-Law of the tea, coffee and short eat shops in Yatiyanthota Pradeshiya Sabha
If  only  any  person  has  a  valid  license  issued  by  the  Chairman  of  any  premises  within  the  area  of  the
Yatiyanthota Pradeshiya Sabha (hereinafter referred to as the area shall run a coffee shop or a snack bar.
